attempts.summary: Stood up a fresh 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6), wrote application keys, then simulated the permanent loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and wiping its data directory while node1/node2 retained quorum. Removed the dead member (551e3d60e1e0c3b9) via etcdctl, added a new member for node3 (87e9d437b9aadf7d) with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started etcd fresh on node3 — it rejoined, synced via raft, and now serves all original application keys. Verified 3/3 healthy members and full data integrity. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), confirmed each node's boot_id changed post-reboot, and verified etcd came back active with full 3-member health and intact application data after each restart.
